Nora (PM): Proposal: ship a conservative Optimize Recommendations v0 for two pilots. Scope: 1) read-only recs (batching/caching knobs + quant suggestions) surfaced via API; 2) daily eval-triggered alerts (configurable thresholds + notify channels); 3) basic ops controls (mute, revert, canary flags). Goal: minimize runtime changes for pilots.

Tian (EngML): Love the read-only first approach. For quant suggestions we should only recommend non-invasive options (e.g., lower precision on last-layer only) unless tenant explicitly opts in. Add a "safe_mode" flag per tenant.

Priya (Data): Eval metrics proposal: token-level perplexity delta, top-1/top-3 concordance, and effective cache hit impact (tokens saved). Suggest default alert thresholds but allow tenant overrides. Example: "concordance < 0.9 for 3d" -> warning.

Lee (SRE): Operational constraints: require a canary rollout plan (5% -> 25% -> 100%) with automatic rollback on latency spike (p95 > baseline *1.3) or error-rate increase (+1.5x). Also need short retention for debugging traces (7d) for pilots.

Cam (Design): Admin panel needs quick controls: toggle recs on/off, preview expected token-savings estimate, and a compact alert summary. I'll mock a compact widget that fits the routes dashboard.

Nora (PM): Launch criteria: 1) two pilots onboarded; 2) telemetry tags emitted (`rec_source`, `suggested_quant`, `est_tokens_saved`, `alert_reason`); 3) no more than 3 customer-visible regressions in pilot month; 4) docs + runbook published. Timeline: 6 weeks.

Tian (EngML): For telemetry add sample schema and minimal payload size. We can embed `est_tokens_saved` as integer. Also require a flag on rec objects: "risk_level": "low|medium|high".

Priya (Data): For eval-runner I'll assemble small ground-truth sets from Notesly and synthetic private examples for AcmeHealth. Will share threshold recommendations by EOW.

Lee (SRE): I'll draft the canary playbook and healthcheck queries. Also request that recs are initially compute-free (precomputed daily) not inline, to avoid runtime cost.

deploy-bot: Staging deploy queued for 1746127000 :rocket:

Nora (PM): Owners & next steps: Tian -> rec API schema + safe_mode flag (due Tue). Priya -> eval baselines & thresholds (due Fri). Lee -> canary playbook + alert actions (due Mon). Cam -> compact widget mock (due Wed). I'll coordinate pilot legal + onboarding invites. Thanks! :tada:
